'''Capypapa''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Capywata]] at 4 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "What are humans always rushing around for? Capypapa hasn't the faintest idea, and the only things worth caring about are oranges and the next sunset."

Capypapa is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Capypapa is a darker blue capybara with a lighter blue capybara (Capywata) on its back. On the lighter blue capybara is an orange. Both capybaras have a pinkish mouth, darker blue accents on its ears and paws, and a lighter underbelly. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "[[Capywata]] loves to sit comfortably atop Capypapa. This is life."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "The gentle Capypapa can always be spotted with a young Capywata on top. The oranges are shared with other Tatari friends."

==Strategy==
[[File:Capypapa Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Capypapa's attack range]]
Good early game healer, use in conjunction with [[Dozy]]/[[Snoozebo]] and other healers to make a stronger tank, or just use to bolster your weakest lanes health.
